camdrones.record.mode.flashback.tooltip: Videos, photos and waypoint recordings of the gimbal camera go into the Flashback recording as a camera path – also in the background without live view and without FPS cost. When the drone is out of sight, the server sends its surroundings along.
camdrones.record.mode.direct.tooltip: Records the gimbal picture directly as a video or photo into the propwash/recordings folder. Works only in live view: as pilot, as camera operator or in the live view from the flight planner.
camdrones.record.needs_flashback: Flashback recording needs the Flashback mod (Fabric)
camdrones.record.incompatible: This Flashback version is not supported – direct recording applies
camdrones.record.needs_live_view: Direct recording needs the live view – Flashback mode records in the background
camdrones.record.flashback.handed_over: Gimbal camera path handed to Flashback: scene “%s” with %s keyframes
camdrones.record.flashback.empty: Flashback recording ended without a camera path: Flashback recorded nothing in that time
camdrones.record.flashback.refused: The camera path could not be handed to Flashback
camdrones.guide.scene.recording.title: Recording: Flashback or direct
camdrones.guide.scene.recording.step.mod: In the K menu, tab “Camera drones”, choose the mode under “Recording”. It applies to videos, photos and waypoint recordings.
camdrones.guide.scene.recording.step.fla: The gimbal writes its camera path into the Flashback recording, even without live view. You render the film later in Flashback.
camdrones.guide.scene.recording.step.dir: Records the gimbal picture right away as a video or photo, but only in live view: as pilot, as camera operator or in the live view.
K menu → Camera drones → Recording mode
